answer: AI-agent markets handling canyon mapping, trellis sensing, or quill archiving can deter Sybil attacks using zero-knowledge passport nullifiers. An agent generates a zero-knowledge proof of a state-signed passport signature and outputs a deterministic scope-bound nullifier hash, blocking reuse without exposing personal data. Each fake identity requires a distinct authentic passport, a scarce physical credential. However, this excludes non-passport holders and trusts sovereign issuers.
